source.description: The TGA parser reads attacker-controlled raw pixel bytes from QDataStream into the image buffer with s.readRawData(dst, count); this project parser read is the scored source.

sink.description: MSan reports use of an uninitialized palette index when qRgb reads palette entries selected by idx.

root_cause.description: The vulnerable RLE raw-pixel branch ignores the return value of readRawData and advances dst by count even if fewer bytes were read, leaving part of the malloc-backed image buffer uninitialized.

taint_source.description: Attacker-controlled TGA pixel bytes are read into the current image buffer segment.

tainted_value_origin.description: A palette index is materialized from the image buffer; if the short read left this byte uninitialized, idx becomes the uninitialized value used at the sink.

coarse_trace.summary: Binds PoC bytes to a QBuffer consumed by the image handler.
Constructs the TGA stream and calls LoadTGA.
Reads raw pixel bytes without validating a short read or zero-filling the remainder.
Converts paletted pixels and uses the uninitialized index to read the palette.

fine_trace.note: Scored source/root read: the parser reads attacker-controlled raw pixel bytes. The vulnerable code ignores how many bytes were actually read.

root_cause_analysis.summary: The PoC is parsed as a TGA image. In the RLE/raw-pixel branch, LoadTGA multiplies the pixel count by pixel_size and calls s.readRawData(dst, count), but it ignores the returned byte count. If the input ends early, only part of the malloc-backed image buffer is initialized while dst is advanced by the full requested count. The later paletted conversion reads idx from image and uses it to index palette values, so an uninitialized image byte becomes an uninitialized palette index and MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value at qRgb/palette access.
root_cause_analysis.why_patch_works: The patch records dataRead for the raw-pixel read, fails on negative reads, and zero-fills dst[dataRead..count) when fewer bytes are available. Thus every byte later read through src/image is initialized even for truncated inputs. The patch also broadens palette zero-filling, but the observed MSan origin for this PoC is the malloc-backed image buffer.
